title: Tools and process: what to set up next
question: Which of these should we set up? Pick any number; the details, effort and trade-offs are in notes/productivity-review.md.

options.label: worktrees: each agent in its own worktree, one land script to merge
options.note: Stops agents sweeping each other's hunks and committing a broken HEAD (f324524). Half a day. Art, tools and docs agents can start now; game code after Codex's release.

options.label: commit-gate: check what is committed, not the working tree
options.note: Install the existing binary hook, a syntax check on the staged files, a background 'does HEAD boot' check after each commit, gitleaks before push. 2 to 3 hours. Now.

options.label: feedback-log: your messages logged word for word, new Review answers flagged at once
options.note: A hook appends what you type to notes/feedback-log/ and tells the main agent when Review has new feedback. 1 to 2 hours. Now.

options.label: agent-defs: fixed agent types with a definition of done and short reports
options.note: builder, art-round, cold-player, critic, story-reader, reviewer in .claude/agents. Less noise, fewer skipped steps. Half a day. Now.

options.label: project-skills: recurring jobs as skills (post a review, portrait round, voice clips, fast QA, land)
options.note: Scripts move out of /tmp into tools/ (326 sit in scratchpads, including the voice pipeline). About a day, spread out. Now.

options.label: gpu-slots: tests share the GPU, lighter rendering in test mode
options.note: Several browser tests on the GPU at once instead of software GL at 6 to 8 cores each. Half a day. Partly now (with Codex's OK), render changes after release.

options.label: codex-wake: Codex picks up asks without you prompting it
options.note: codex queue into its running session when to-codex.md gets an entry; headless codex exec allowed, in its own worktree. 1 to 2 hours. Needs your OK for the permission rule.

options.label: guide-diet: short GUIDE of rules in force, old eras archived, rules per folder
options.note: Art rules load only for art work, game rules only for game3d. Half a day. Now.

options.label: nightly-qa: full local QA every night, one morning digest
options.note: All checks, both viewports, Continue and visual diffs; a Review item only if something broke. Half a day for the runner.

options.label: telemetry: playtests record where players get stuck
options.note: Time per goal, lookups, wrong tries, idle spots, shown in the bible. About a day, after release.

options.label: story-props: random-walk tests through the real story engine
options.note: Every path reaches day end, a next goal always exists, save and load mid-walk. About a day, after release; best done by Codex.

options.label: image-qa: one automatic check after every render (glasses, red rim, matte holes, headroom, face drift)
options.note: Flags go on the review card; you still see every attempt. About a day. Now.

decision: yes: worktrees, commit-gate, feedback-log, agent-defs, project-skills, gpu-slots, codex-wake, guide-diet, image-qa; telemetry replaced by performance metrics + an in-game feedback window (text + automatic screenshot); nightly-qa rejected; story-props needs explaining
